summary: Reconstructed the figure as a compiled TikZ parallelogram ABCD. Four vertices come from bound point labels (A top-right, B right-middle, C bottom-left, D left-middle). Sides AB, BC, CD, DA are drawn solid, plus a horizontal diagonal DB. No circles were detected. Right-angle marks at B and D were not verified by CV, so none are drawn. The critic scored v1 at 0.9 with all four labels present and geometry matching. Its only issue was that the BD stroke looked thinner. v2 removed the per-segment width override, and the source now matches the other sides, but the critic still reports it thin. v2 has not been re-scored, so best_version still points to v1.
